title: Chapter 463: Eternal Continent
content:
Chapter 463: Eternal Continent

"Me, I feel like my blood is boiling all over my body!"

Some people clenched their fists, and they couldn't hide their excitement.

Some people have their eyes radiating, looking full of expectations for the future.

What ambition is this to liberate the whole world.

Only the lord of the deserted city would say such words.

Beside Lu Daosheng, everyone looked at Lu Daosheng with an extremely respectful look in their eyes. They all knew in their hearts that Lu Daosheng was not just talking about it, but that he would definitely do it.

Feeling the gradually rising atmosphere of everyone, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly and then slowly took off.

Under everyone's gaze, Lu Daosheng stretched his arms as if he wanted to embrace the whole world.

The next moment, an unspeakable strangeness swept over.

Everyone was slightly stunned, their faces filled with confusion.

"What did the city lord do?"

They could only slightly feel the ground and space seemed to shake, but after experiencing it carefully, it suddenly disappeared.

"This, this is,"

Lu Xue and others seemed to have seen something, all of whom opened their mouths and their eyes widened, looking very surprised.

The next moment, a shocking scene appeared.

The outer barriers of the Chaos Realm gradually dissipated, and strange worlds emerged around the Chaos Realm, and then continued to gather here.

At first glance, it was dense and countless worlds were pulled over by Lu Daosheng with his supreme power.

"My God, am I dreaming?"

"This, this is really unreal."

"Is this what the city lord said to liberate the whole world?"

It turns out that this is literal.

Lu Daosheng actually led all the world over, and the rest of the land was transformed into boundless chaos.

The creatures in the Chaos Realm were so shocked, and even more so in those creatures in the world.

After they reacted, they found that the world seemed to have changed a lot.

Rumble!

The earth shook, and a strong tremor came from the earth.

The magnificent sound kept coming, which was the sound from different worlds.

Countless worlds reacted in a series of ways, but Lu Daosheng continued to exert his power. What he wanted was a unified world.

Lu Xue looked at this shocking scene and her understanding of her father seemed to be higher.

And at this moment, a familiar beautiful figure came from afar.

Lu Xue was slightly stunned and immediately said excitedly: "Mom!"

Everyone around was stunned and looked in that direction, all screaming.

"Madam of the City Lord!"

The person who came was Yan Lingyun.

At this time, Yan Lingyun's eyes were a little tired, but more so, she was still happy when she saw Lu Daosheng and Lu Xue.

"Xiaoxue, I'm late."

Yan Lingyun walked up to hug Lu Xue, her face filled with a gentle smile.

Then, Yan Lingyun looked at Lu Daosheng next to her.

Under the curious eyes of Lu Xue and everyone around him, Yan Lingyun spread her delicate palms, and a bright and irregular and constantly changing light source emerged.

"Here, this is what you want, I've brought it to you."

Lu Daosheng looked at this thing, but without refusal, he took it directly.

"Lingyun, thank you for your hard work."

Lu Daosheng sighed lightly, looking at Yan Lingyun with a little apology.

But Yan Lingyun shook her head slightly, "This is what I should do. We are husband and wife, and we should help each other."

Lu Daosheng wanted to do this by himself, but Yan Lingyun saw that Lu Daosheng was suffering today, so she took the initiative to take on this tiring job.

Lu Daosheng has always been omnipotent, and he has almost become a useless vase that can only be appreciated.

So she was eager to help Lu Daosheng.

On the side, Lu Xue blinked Shui Lingling's big eyes, gently pulled Yan Lingyun's neck of clothes, and asked curiously: "Mom, what is that?"

Yan Lingyun looked at Lu Xue and chuckled, "That is the true source of the world."

"The true source of the world? What does it mean?"

Lu Xue's expression was even more confused. This was the first time she had heard such a statement.

Around them, Huang Shou and others also looked puzzled, and they didn't know what the true source of the world was.

They only know the origin of the world.

That is the basics of a world.

In response, Lu Daosheng explained: "The true source of the world is different from the origin of the world. Once the origin is missing, it will be irreversible to a world, but the true source is different. The true source is endless. Its only function is to prove this. The world is real."

“It’s almost everywhere.”

As he said that, Lu Daosheng made a move of his hand, and a light source similar to that which Yan Lingyun took out just now appeared in Lu Daosheng's palm, but in comparison, it seemed much dim.

"This is the true source of the Chaos Realm."

Seeing this scene, everyone seemed to understand it, but Lu Xue still wondered, "Dad, what do you want this thing to do?"

For a while, she really couldn't imagine what this thing would be useful.

Hearing Lu Xue’s question, Lu Daosheng laughed, “Your father, I’ll keep it a secret first, you’ll know after a while.”

"Ao."

Seeing that Lu Daosheng was unwilling to say it, Lu Xue didn't ask much.

Lu Daosheng looked at the true source of the world that Yan Lingyun gave to him in his palm. This is the true source of the world that Yan Lingyun personally traveled through countless worlds. It was superimposed on each other, and the effect was already very powerful.

This is a key thing that Lu Daosheng wants to save the world and cannot be missing.

At this time, the process of countless worlds connecting has gradually come to an end.

Under Lu Daosheng's deliberate actions, the powerful world is in the middle, and the surrounding worlds weaken outward one by one.

Countless worlds combine with each other to form an unprecedented supercontinent.

Next, countless forms of creatures will have different beliefs and different lifestyles to contact and merge with each other.

This requires a long process.

But Lu Daosheng believes that the remaining time must be enough.

All this is thanks to his proud disciple.

Lu Daosheng looked in one direction.

There is the boundary of the universe.

The world does not know that the world they live in is on the verge of collapse, and there, there is a group of great and selfless beings who are carrying the burden for them.

"Everything will be fine, believe me, I will bring you light."

Lu Daosheng did not say this out loud, but murmured in his heart.

Then, Lu Daosheng retracted his thoughts and looked around.

A brand new world and a brand new adventure are all filled on this newly established supercontinent.

Next, the creatures of the Chaos Realm and the powerful people of the Desolate City will, under the guidance of Lu Daosheng, liberate the world step by step until the world is unified.

Of course, Lu Daosheng will only give guidance and will not do it himself.

He has more important things to do.

In the main hall of the Desolate City Lord's Mansion.

Lu Daosheng held a long-awaited meeting.

The main content of this meeting was to talk about the future direction of the Desolate City and the Chaos Realm.

First of all, Lu Daosheng named this super continent - the Eternal Continent.
